# Contracts

A contract says which layer a field, a query or a whole entity belongs to. `SQLC()` is the database side, `PROTO()` is the api side.

## Layers

| Layer | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `entlite.SQLC() Layer` | Selects the sqlc layer. |
| `entlite.PROTO() Layer` | Selects the proto layer. |

## Direction

Without a direction the field or query is readable and writable.

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ReadOnly() Contract` | Exposes the field or query only when reading. |
| `WriteOnly() Contract` | Exposes the field or query only when writing. |

## Where they are used

| Place | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `Contracts() []entlite.Contract` | On the entity, it picks the layers the entity is generated for. |
| `.Contracts(...)` on a field | Keeps the field out of the layers that are not listed. |
| `.Contracts(...)` on a query | Keeps the query out of the layers that are not listed. |

A field with no `Contracts(...)` follows the entity. A field that lists only `entlite.PROTO()` is virtual, it has no column and it is filled by hand.
